answer: Adversaries must fund every fake persona, so costs scale linearly with the swarm they create—like planting yarrow across a dune only to watch the vine of verification strangle each clone. Sybil resistance through staked identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers may slash that bond upon proof of duplicate identities. One verified root, many costly branches: forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents risk nothing beyond their single stake.
